title: S3 buckets cheap enumeration
description: Enumerates S3 bucket names and regions via the list-only resource; identifiers only, no detail.
template: SELECT bucket_name, region FROM aws.s3.buckets_list_only WHERE region = '{{region}}';
notes: S3 bucket listing is account-global; the region routes the request. Pair with aws/s3/bucket-detail for per-bucket attributes, one request per bucket.
